metadata.case_name: YEUNG SHUI MING v. GONG KONG SANG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: injuries to head; abrasions over forehead and left maxilla; hematoma over left occiput
source: "… injuries to head, right shoulder, neck abrasions over forehead and left maxilla; hematoma over left occiput; tenderness over right shoulder."
"… injuries to head, right shoulder, neck abrasions over forehead and left maxilla; hematoma over left occiput; tenderness over right shoulder."
"The range of movement of neck is decreased, … due to pain …"
injuries.icd_description: Acute whiplash associated disorder with complaint of neck pain with musculoskeletal signs

injuries.description: right shoulder injury; tenderness over right shoulder
source: "… injuries to head, right shoulder, neck abrasions over forehead and left maxilla; hematoma over left occiput; tenderness over right shoulder."
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive symptoms
source: They concluded that the plaintiff was suffering from adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressive symptoms.

injuries.description: post-concussion syndrome (referred to and recorded in consultation notes; not established as concluded by the court)
source: Most of the consultation notes referred to post-concussion syndrome.

manifestations.description: pain and tenderness of the right shoulder
pain and tenderness of the neck
decreased range of movement of neck due to pain
dizziness / heavy-headedness (persistent complaint in consultation notes)
unstable mood and suicidal idea (recorded in October 2004 report)
numbness of the neck and right shoulder (claimed by plaintiff)
persistent headache (claimed by plaintiff, though consultation notes recorded no headache except on one or two occasions)
poor memory / difficulty registering things (noted by neurology specialist and psychiatrist)
change in use of hands (plaintiff alleged he used to be right handed but mainly used left hand after the accident)

treatments_received: Accident and Emergency treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital (treated and discharged)
Consultations at Jockey Club Health Centre
Referrals and consultations at Neurosurgery Department of Tuen Mun Hospital
Consultations at Psychiatry Department of Tuen Mun Hospital
Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scan of brain (results normal)
Magnetic Resonance Angiography (MRA) scan of cervical blood vessels (results normal)

losses.description: Pain and suffering and loss of amenities (general damages awarded by the court)
